Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 7. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document.

8. Warranty Over and above the normal Warranty terms as per GeM GTC, the successful bidder / OEM shall have to provide Comprehensive Warranty during the entire Standard warranty period as per contract. : The comprehensive warranty shall be covering the following scope 2 YEARS WARRANTY AND 8 YEARS CMC (Upload an undertaking with the bid confirming compliance by the bidder if Bidder is taking onus of this compliance. In case OEM is taking onus of this compliance, OEM undertaking is to be uploaded along with Bidder undertaking) 9. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 2 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 10. Warranty Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period: After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 3 days time limit. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification with defined time limit, a penalty of 0.5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from the seller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to recover all such penalty amount from the Performance Security (PBG).Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 10% of the total contract value after which the Buyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of PBG. Seller shall be liable to re-imberse the cost of such service / rectification to the Buyer. 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses THE FIRM SHOULD BE QUOTED TENDER AS PER OUR TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS, THE SPECIFIC ATIONS GIVEN BELOW :- Revised Technical Specifications for the Purchase of Syringe Infusion P umps 55nos – (35+20) nos 1. The device should have valid certifications such as BIS/ISO/European CE/US FDA/ CE. 2. The equipment should be a syringe infusion pump. 3. It should have programmable operation modes. 4. The pump should support syringe sizes of 5 ml, 10 ml, 20 ml, and 50 ml. 5. The flow rate range should be 1.1 to 840 ml/hr (for 50 ml syringe). 6. The infused volume range should be 0.1 to 999 ml, with 0.1 ml increments. 7. The Keep Vein Open (KVO) rate should be 5 ml/hr. 8. The accuracy should be 2% of the syringe. 9. The device should have a bolus function with volume pre-selection. 10. The bolus rate range should be up to 800 ml/hr (for 50 ml syringe). 11. The bolus volume should be programmable in ml. 12. The display should be of LCD type.

13. It should have a rechargeable lead-acid battery. 14. Fuse specifications should be 220V, 2A × 2 and 12V, 2A × 2. 15. The device should support multiple infusion modes, including: · Rate mode · Drip mode · Wait mode · Time mode 16. The equipment should have a 2-year warranty and 8 years Comprehensive Maintenance Co ntract (CMC) after the warranty period. 17. The device should include a dynamic pressure monitoring system with adjustable minimum a nd maximum thresholds.It must have an occlusion pressure pre-alarm at 5 ml/hr with the following specifications: · At 2 psi (150 mmHg): alarm within < 2 minutes · At 8 psi (600 mmHg): alarm within < 5 minutes 18. The device should be safe for neonatal use and include a drug library with a minimum of 3 800 drugs categorized into at least 19 categories. 19. The device should come with a dedicated steel stand for the pump attachment and within built ele ctrical connectivity to the pumps. 20. The device should have an RS232 communication port with HL7 compatibility. 21. The battery backup should be at least 11 hours at 5 ml/hr when fully charged. 22. The device should support up to 100 types of syringes. 23. It should be programmable for durations ranging from 1 minute to 24 hours, with minute-to-m inute increments. 24. The device should display system messages, including preventive maintenance warnings. 25. A compliance and conformity statement of the quoted model, along with documentary evid ence (original brochure), must be submitted at the time of bidding. 26. Demonstration at PGI should be provided if require 1. TO PROVIDE THE MANUFACUTRER AUTHORIZATION CERTIFICATE (3 OEM) 2. VALIDITY OF BID TO BE MINIMUM 330 DAYS. 3. WARRANTY 2 YEARS AND CMC 8 YEARS. 4 BIDDER SHOULD BE SUBMITTED EMD IN THE SHPE OF FDR/TDR IN THE FAVOUR OF POST GRADUATE INS TITUTE OF MEDICAL EDUCATION AND RESERACH., CHANDIGARH 5 THE CERTIFICATE OF AUTHORIZATION LOCAL CONTENT % CERTIFICATE 25% BID VALIDTY CERTIFICATE A ND WARRANTY AND CMC CERTIFICATE TO BE ATTACHED IN THE FRONT OF THE BID DOCUMENTS. .
